exports.name: classify_structural
exports.behavior: Returns ten full-block raw masks using safe unsigned byte iteration. Recognizes six ASCII punctuation characters, exactly four JSON whitespace characters, controls below 0x20, ASCII digits, and bytes at least 0x80. Preserves whitespace/control overlap and maps byte i to bit i. Performs no allocation, quote filtering, carry update, JSON validation, or UTF-8 validation. The function has no error path.

test_vectors.coverage: Literal expected masks for all punctuation, space, tab, CR, LF, ASCII digit endpoints, slash, 0x1f, DEL, 0x80, 0xff, quotes, backslashes, vertical tab, and form feed. Explicit whitespace/control overlap.
All 256 homogeneous full blocks compared against independent byte-set membership, including all-zero and all-one masks.
All 256 byte values isolated at each of 64 positions, including bits 0 and 63, with unrelated positions required to remain clear.
256 deterministic wrapping byte ramps; per-byte membership assertions, disjoint punctuation classes, punctuation union, and non-ASCII class independence.
A fixed block borrowed at offset one within a larger array, with distinguishable adjacent bytes and explicit first/last-bit expectations.
UTF-8 encodings of NBSP, EM SPACE, LINE SEPARATOR, Arabic-Indic zero, fullwidth zero, and fullwidth colon set only non-ASCII bits.
Quoted punctuation, raw tab, NUL, invalid UTF-8, and digits retain their individual masks; quote analysis excludes only quoted punctuation from the assembled structural mask.
All live lengths from 0 through 64 clip every class and the punctuation union, with exact valid length, valid mask, and scalar backend tag.
Raw padded zeros set control bits; final assembly removes them for empty and one-byte blocks while retaining them for full blocks.
Integration error paths for lengths 65, 255, 256, and usize::MAX require InvalidToken, Scanner source, offset zero, zero schema/field identifiers, and nonempty error detail.
Oversized input and noncanonical quote carry produce the frozen scanner errors without mutating quote state or opaque UTF-8 state; covers empty, one-byte, and full-block input.
